q: Which Meta campaigns are wasting money?

checks.what: tool: uses spend plus an outcome metric

answer:
Short answer — these Meta campaigns are clearly burning ad budget (last 30 days): they spent meaningfully on Meta and produced negative product-level net profit (losses) and net ROAS below their break‑even ROAS.

Top measured offenders (2026-09-13..2026-10-12, numbers from product_pnl):
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+ (120250695088250783) — Ad spend: ₹73,137 (Measured); Net profit: ₹-32,431 (Measured); Net ROAS: 0.56 (Measured) vs Break‑even ROAS: 1.42 (Measured). — Derived: net ROAS < break‑even → running below breakeven.  
- TH-222-WINGBIRD-23SEP (120250597947340783) — Ad spend: ₹73,105 (Measured); Net profit: ₹-15,008 (Measured); Net ROAS: 0.79 (Measured) vs BE ROAS: 1.57 (Measured). — Derived: below breakeven.  
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-29SEP (120250726752410783) — Ad spend: ₹56,657 (Measured); Net profit: ₹-20,702 (Measured); Net ROAS: 0.63 (Measured) vs BE ROAS: 1.34 (Measured). — Derived: below breakeven.  
- DOG TOY CS-24SEP (120250667421200783) — Ad spend: ₹34,634 (Measured); Net profit: ₹-25,589 (Measured); Net ROAS: 0.26 (Measured) vs BE ROAS: 2.18 (Measured). — Derived: far below breakeven.  
- CAT TOY CS-26SEP (120250695726350783) — Ad spend: ₹33,853 (Measured); Net profit: ₹-16,381 (Measured); Net ROAS: 0.52 (Measured) vs BE ROAS: 1.53 (Measured). — Derived: below breakeven.

Also measured: there are other campaigns with negative product_net_profit in the same window (e.g. TH-383-SUSPENDER-20JUNE, TH-383-SUSPENDER-26JUNE-ADV+, MONSOON-CTL-20JULY). Ad‑spend for some of those was not returned in the limited top-N ad‑spend part of this query — they still show measured losses and should be checked (Measured).

Caveats: queries used product_pnl (product-level P&L), filtered to ad_platform=meta and default brand (Tilting Heads). The results spanned multiple time axes and the query hit row limits; some campaigns are missing ad_spend rows in this result set. Data freshness: last_30d (2026-09-13..2026-10-12) · INR · cube refresh 2026-10-13T17:44:42Z (Measured).

Suggested next step: pick 1–2 of the big spend losers (e.g. the two TH‑383 campaigns or TH‑222) — shall I (a) run diagnose_metric_change to find why (CTR, AOV, returns, creative) or (b) drill the same window by adset/creative to find the bad creatives?
